analysis:
CHANGELOG.md only: documentation changes, with no executable or configuration changes. The base excerpt (lines 1499-1683) is old release history. The head excerpt (lines 1-236) adds an 'Unreleased - typical MTP acceptance' entry at lines 3-6. It describes per-model typical MTP draft acceptance for sampled requests (`[backend] mtp_acceptance`, default `exact`) and a pinned mlx-swift-lm SDK. The head also carries many existing 'Unreleased' entries, including the 0.9.18 candidate, coordinator upgrade safety, frozen legacy MDM authorization, account erasure, and cache reliability. I did not confirm whether these are new in this PR or were only reordered; the visible changelog text does not include any code.

Security-relevant observations for later passes: the typical-acceptance MTP change affects sampled-request inference correctness only (T-007, T-056); the doc says greedy requests are unchanged. The actual provider and SDK code, the pin bump, and the config parser are not in this batch, so they were not reviewed. Reviewers should check that the config default stays `exact`, that the pinned SDK commit is intended, and that the TB-007 hash domain and the output-correctness claims in T-056 are not overstated. The changelog documents default-off soft-delete mutations (line 34), the frozen legacy MDM cohort (lines 178-189) and provider-bound field minimization (line 166). These match the canonical-context claims about TB-009 and TB-011, and I saw no contradiction. Because only the changelog is visible here, I make no claim about the underlying code.
